response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID AS ID, P.SEX AS SEX, AVG(L.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(L.IGA - L.IGM) AS avg_diff FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), r AS (SELECT ID, SEX, avg_pt, avg_diff, avg_diff / AVG(avg_diff) OVER () AS ratio FROM p) SELECT SEX, AVG(avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(avg_diff) AS avg_iga_minus_igm, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM r WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL AND SEX <> '' GROUP BY SEX
